home.hero_tagline: A calm alchemy sort puzzle. Pour glowing elemental ores between glass tubes until each one holds a single, pure element.
home.about_h2: Sort the elements. Find some quiet.
home.about_lead: Tap a tube, tap another, and the top ores pour across — stacking colour on colour until every tube holds one clean element. No timers. No lives. No energy that runs out. Just you, the ores, and as many unhurried minutes as you'd like.
home.feat_h2: Built for calm, not for clicks

feat.b: Alchemy isn't a coat of paint. The seven elements are the colours you sort, transmutation is a real move, and the four chapters are your arc — the story and the rules are the same thing.
A prima-materia wildcard ore pours into any tube, then permanently transmutes into a true element the moment it settles. A move the sort genre simply doesn't have.
Every element bursts with its own effect, the haptics are tuned to the moment, and the music answers the difficulty. Satisfying by design, not by accident.
Each element ore has its own sculpted shape, not just a colour — with optional symbols and colourblind-friendly palettes for cues you can always trust.
No energy, no lives, no timers. Undo and restart are free and unlimited — the game never charges you for a mistake or makes you wait to play.
Stars are graded against the solver's own optimal solution — and clearing a board with no hints or undo earns a Flawless. Every level is solver-verified, so the challenge is real, never random.

home.el_h2: Seven ores, each with its own glow
home.craft_h2: A little alchemy in every board

craft.b: A special colourless ore pours freely into any tube — then transmutes, crystallising into a true element as it settles into place. A small moment of alchemy when you need it.
Clear a level with the essential moves alone — no hints, no undo — and earn a Flawless: a perfect transmutation, marked with its own crimson stars.
Work from Foundations through Crucible and Confluence to The Great Work — the lab deepens as your hands learn it.

privacy.meta_desc: Elixa's privacy policy: no accounts, no ads, no personal data — only anonymous analytics.
privacy.body:
Elixa (“the game”, “we”, “us”) is a puzzle game published by Mateus Amaral. This policy explains what data the game handles and why. We do not sell your data, show you ads, require an account, or track your identity.

Summary

  • No accounts, no login, no personal information collected.
  • No advertising and no ad networks.
  • No third-party tracking or data brokers.
  • Your game progress is stored only on your device.
  • We collect anonymous, aggregate gameplay analytics to make the game better. These analytics cannot identify you.

What we collect

1. On-device game data (never leaves your device)

Your level progress, stars, and app settings are saved locally on your device using standard app storage. This data is not transmitted to us and is removed if you uninstall the game or use the in-game “Reset progress” option.

2. Anonymous gameplay analytics

To understand how the game is played and improve difficulty and performance, the game sends anonymous gameplay events to our analytics provider, PostHog. Events are ingested through PostHog’s United States endpoint, and the client’s IP address is stripped and never stored. These events describe gameplay, not people. Examples of what is sent:

  • Which level was started, solved, or abandoned, and how long it took.
  • Number of moves, undos, and invalid moves (to calibrate difficulty).
  • Anonymous rendering-performance samples (frame timings) to detect stutter on different devices.
  • Coarse technical context: device model, operating-system version, app build type, and a randomly generated, self-minted anonymous identifier that is not linked to you, your device’s advertising ID, your name, email, or any account.

We do not collect your name, email address, phone number, precise location, contacts, photos, advertising identifiers, or any other personal or sensitive information. We never ask you to sign in.

The anonymous identifier is a random value created for analytics grouping only; it is not tied to your identity and cannot be used to contact or re-identify you.

Why we collect it

Solely to operate and improve the game — balancing puzzle difficulty, finding and fixing performance problems, and understanding which features are used. We have a legitimate interest in improving the product; the data is anonymous and minimal.

Who processes the data

  • PostHog — product analytics, used to store and aggregate the anonymous events above. See PostHog’s privacy information at https://posthog.com/privacy.

We do not share data with advertisers or data brokers, and we do not sell data.

Data retention

Anonymous analytics events are retained by our analytics provider for a limited period for aggregate analysis and then expire. On-device data persists until you delete it or uninstall the game.

Children’s privacy

Elixa does not knowingly collect personal information from anyone, including children. Because we collect no personal or identifying information and show no ads, the game does not build profiles of any user.

Your choices

  • Reset progress: clear all on-device progress from the in-game Settings.
  • Uninstall: removes all on-device data.
  • Contact us (below) with any privacy question or request.

Changes to this policy

If this policy changes, we will update the “Last updated” date above and post the new version at this URL.

Contact

Questions about privacy: mateusl.amaral@gmail.com

support.meta_desc: Get help with Elixa, report a bug, or ask a privacy question.
support.body:
Need help with Elixa, found a bug, or have a privacy question? We’d love to hear from you.

Email: mateusl.amaral@gmail.com

Before you write

To help us reproduce an issue quickly, it’s useful to include:

  • Your device model and operating-system version.
  • The app version (shown in the in-game Settings).
  • A short description of what happened and what you expected.

Common questions

How do I reset my progress?

Open the in-game Settings and use Reset progress. This clears all on-device data. Uninstalling the game also removes everything.

Do you collect my personal data?

No. Elixa has no accounts, no ads, and collects no personal information — only anonymous, aggregate gameplay analytics. See the Privacy Policy.

Is there a cost or subscription?

Elixa is designed as a pay-once game — one unlock removes ads and opens the full collection. No subscriptions. (The game is in closed testing and not yet publicly available.)
